verdicts.reason: A is basically a shrunken copy of the portrait layout dropped into the middle of the banner. The left edges don't line up (BLOOM, headline, subtitle, steps and CTA each start at a different x), there is a lot of empty space on both sides, and the step copy and legal text are tiny. Still, the reading order and grouping are intact. B makes the headline and CTA big, but it breaks the three steps apart: 01 and 03 sit at the top, 02 at the bottom, so they read out of order. Their text is too small to read, and the subtitle floats alone on the left, so the ritual content is effectively lost.
